# Repository-wide Copilot instructions

This repository is the personal-account default community-health repository
for `frasermolyneux`. It also maintains the engineering-estate dashboard and
the synchronization that generates it.

## Repository scope

- `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` and `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` are inherited
  by repositories that do not define local overrides. Keep them concise,
  technology-neutral, and broadly applicable.
- `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`,
  `docs/index.md`, and `docs/_config.yml` are maintained manually.
- `scripts/estate-sync/estate_sync.py` is the synchronization source.
- `.github/workflows/estate-sync.yml` installs its runtime dependencies and
  runs the synchronization.
- `docs/estate/` is generated by the synchronization script. Do not edit those
  pages directly; change the generator or upstream `platform-workloads` data
  when generated output must change.

## Working guidance

- Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the concise execution brief and targeted
  commands.
- Preserve the generated/manual boundary and avoid running the synchronization
  for unrelated documentation or template work.
- Treat changes to inherited templates as cross-repository changes. Do not add
  requirements that assume a particular language, framework, cloud, deployment
  model, database, package manager, or repository layout.
- Prefer repository-native instructions and the files relevant to the task.
  Do not assume another repository contains shared instruction checkouts,
  custom agents, setup workflows, MCP servers, or identical Copilot features.
- Keep changes within this repository's estate, documentation, workflow, and
  community-health responsibilities.

## Validation

- Markdown or template prose: verify changed relative links resolve, inspect
  rendering structure, and run `git diff --check`.
- Workflow or issue-form YAML:
  `python -c "from pathlib import Path; import yaml; [yaml.safe_load(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in Path('.github').rglob('*.yml')]"`.
- Issue forms: also confirm each form retains `name`, `description`, `body`,
  valid body item types, unique `id` values where required, and required
  `attributes` or `validations`.
- Python:
  `python -m py_compile scripts/estate-sync/estate_sync.py`.
- Do not run `scripts/estate-sync/estate_sync.py` unless regeneration is part
  of the task and its external-data and broad-write effects are intended.

## Security and environment

- Never place secrets, credentials, tokens, private headers, connection
  details, or sensitive external data in tracked files.
- Keep workflow permissions minimal and preserve explicit secret handling.
- Do not expose values obtained from GitHub or Azure DevOps APIs in templates
  or instructions.
- No `copilot-setup-steps.yml` is required. Likely tasks can use the
  runner-provided Python environment; synchronization dependencies are needed
  only when running the existing estate workflow.

See [README.md](../README.md), [the estate dashboard overview](../docs/index.md),
and [the synchronization workflow](workflows/estate-sync.yml) for authoritative
repository context.
